```{r}
#| include: false
root <- normalizePath(here::here())
FAMILY <- "ppa"
.MODEL_CONFIG <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "scripts", "manifest.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
.MODEL_IDS <- as.character(.MODEL_CONFIG$responses$names)
.MODEL_IDS <- .MODEL_IDS[grepl(sprintf("^%s([LTV])?$", FAMILY), .MODEL_IDS)]
.MODEL_SUFFIX <- sub(sprintf("^%s", FAMILY), "", .MODEL_IDS)
.MODEL_KEYS <- ifelse(.MODEL_SUFFIX == "", "resultant", .MODEL_SUFFIX)
if (!length(.MODEL_IDS) ||
    any(!.MODEL_KEYS %in% c("resultant", "L", "T", "V"))) {
  stop("demand.PPA: unsupported response family.", call. = FALSE)
}
if (!exists("COMPONENT_LABELS", inherits = FALSE)) {
  COMPONENT_LABELS <- c(
    resultant = "resultant",
    L = "longitudinal",
    T = "transverse",
    V = "vertical"
  )
}
RESP <- setNames(unname(COMPONENT_LABELS[.MODEL_KEYS]), .MODEL_IDS)
TABS <- setNames(tools::toTitleCase(RESP), .MODEL_IDS)
if (!exists("CAP", inherits = FALSE)) {
  CAP <- "%s PPA as a function of scaled distance $\\mathrm{SD}=d/\\sqrt{q}$. The curves show p50 (solid), p90 (dashed), and p95 (dotted) for the represented MIC values; the points are the observations used for model fitting, distinguished by source."
}
DATASET <- "QDS"
if (!DATASET %in% names(.MODEL_CONFIG$datasets)) {
  stop("demand.PPA: dataset QDS is not declared in the manifest.", call. = FALSE)
}
PathDataset <- file.path(root, "data", "datasets", sprintf("%s.csv", DATASET))
PathDemand <- file.path(root, "data", "export", "Yo.csv")
PathSources <- file.path(root, "data", "domains", "sources.csv")
.MODEL_PATHS <- c(PathDataset, PathDemand, PathSources)
if (any(!file.exists(.MODEL_PATHS))) {
  stop("demand.PPA: required model products are missing.", call. = FALSE)
}
.MODEL_UNITS <- jsonlite::read_json(
  file.path(root, "data", "domains", "units.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE
)
UNIT <- as.character(.MODEL_UNITS[[FAMILY]])
if (length(UNIT) != 1L || is.na(UNIT) || !nzchar(UNIT)) {
  stop("demand.PPA: units.json does not define ppa.", call. = FALSE)
}
.MODEL_Q <- data.table::fread(
  PathDataset,
  select = c("set", "MIC")
)[set == "predict", sort(unique(MIC))]
if (!length(.MODEL_Q) || any(!is.finite(.MODEL_Q))) {
  stop("demand.PPA: the prediction grid does not define finite charges.",
       call. = FALSE)
}
Q.TARGET <- .MODEL_Q[
  unique(round(seq(1, length(.MODEL_Q), length.out = min(6L, length(.MODEL_Q)))))
]
P.TARGET <- c(0.50, 0.90, 0.95)
X_AXIS <- "SD [m/kg^0.5]"
if (!exists("GROUP_LEGEND", inherits = FALSE)) GROUP_LEGEND <- "Condition"
if (!exists("SOURCE_UNKNOWN", inherits = FALSE)) SOURCE_UNKNOWN <- "Unclassified"
SOURCE_COLORS <- c(IMPALA = "#00838f", S11D = "rgba(130,130,130,0.35)")
LINE_FORMAT <- "MIC=%s kg | p%02d"
```

::: {.panel-tabset .full-width}

```{r}
#| results: asis
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
for (.ID in names(RESP)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n#### %s\n\n", TABS[[.ID]]))
  NGR::knitBlock(
    path = "/_fig/demand.PPA.cell.qmd",
    stem = sprintf("fdemand-%s", .ID),
    labels = "rewrite",
      vars = list(
        DATASET = DATASET,
        ID = .ID,
        Q.TARGET = Q.TARGET,
        P.TARGET = P.TARGET,
        UNIT = UNIT,
        X_AXIS = X_AXIS,
        Y_AXIS = sprintf("%s [%s]", .ID, UNIT),
        GROUP_LEGEND = GROUP_LEGEND,
        SOURCE_UNKNOWN = SOURCE_UNKNOWN,
        SOURCE_COLORS = SOURCE_COLORS,
        LINE_FORMAT = LINE_FORMAT,
        PathDataset = PathDataset,
        PathDemand = PathDemand,
        PathSources = PathSources,
        CAPTION = sprintf(CAP, RESP[[.ID]])
      ),
      root = root
  )
}
```

:::

```{r}
#| include: false
rm(CAP, COMPONENT_LABELS, DATASET, FAMILY, GROUP_LEGEND, LINE_FORMAT,
   P.TARGET, PathDataset, PathDemand, PathSources, Q.TARGET, RESP,
   SOURCE_COLORS, SOURCE_UNKNOWN, TABS, UNIT, X_AXIS)
rm(.MODEL_CONFIG, .MODEL_IDS, .MODEL_KEYS, .MODEL_PATHS, .MODEL_Q,
   .MODEL_SUFFIX, .MODEL_UNITS)
if (knitr::is_html_output()) rm(.ID)
```
